name: Ogassa (Spain)
description: Divided into two equal vertical parts, black at the hoist and white at the fly, charged at the centre with the sword of the arms counterchanged.
history: The flag was approved on 23 January 1997 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 2334 of 19 February 1997; it is an oblong flag of 2:3 divided into two equal vertical parts, black at the hoist and white at the fly, with the sword of the arms at the centre, white where it rests on the black and black where it rests on the white.

features.role: sword of the arms in pale counterchanged, white on black and black on white
